card.name: Small words after verbs of change
card.fires_on: Short words like "to", "in", "gets" or "considerably" right after verbs of becoming, coming, growing or decreasing. The next word is a verb or a phrase describing a state or change.

modes.label: "came/grow to"
modes.description: The word "to" follows came or grow, leading into "be known", "be up to", or a place.
modes.example: which came<< to>> be known as the "love apple"

modes.label: Change or trend words
modes.description: An adverb or verb about a gradual change, such as decreases considerably or gets low.
modes.example: The incidence of fatal hepatotoxicity decreases<< considerably>> in progressively older patient groups.
